title: Frequently asked, honestly answered.
subtitle: Quick answers to the questions that come up most before we start working together.

items.q: What kind of projects are you the right fit for?
items.a: Anything where the bar is high: marketing sites that need to feel premium, full-stack products that need to scale, or 3D experiences that have to perform on real-world devices. If 'good enough' is the goal, I'm the wrong hire.

items.q: Do you only work solo or can you join a team?
items.a: Both. I've shipped as a solo full-stack lead and as a senior IC inside larger engineering teams. Either way, I write the kind of code that makes onboarding the next person easy.
Fixed fee for clearly scoped sprints, weekly rate for ongoing engagements. We agree on outcomes and milestones up front so neither of us is guessing.

items.q: What's your stance on AI in the workflow?
items.a: Use it like a sharp intern. AI accelerates research, scaffolding, and refactors, but architecture and product judgment stay human. Every line still gets reviewed.

items.q: Can you redesign an existing product without breaking it?
items.a: Yes. I work in safe, incremental PRs with feature flags and visual regression tests. No 'big bang' rewrites unless that's what the business genuinely needs.
Always, for any serious conversation. Send yours through and I'll sign before our intro call.
